description: This file sets up custom fields, print formats, roles, permissions, and gratuity rules specific to the UAE region within an ERP system, particularly for VAT and payroll configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Main setup function that calls other setup functions for custom fields, print formats, roles, permissions, and gratuity rules.

methods.name: make_custom_fields
methods.description: Defines and creates custom fields for various doctype including Item, Customer, Supplier, and invoice items.

methods.name: add_print_formats
methods.description: Reloads and enables specific print formats related to tax invoices.

methods.name: add_custom_roles_for_reports
methods.description: Creates a custom role for the UAE VAT report if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Sets permissions for UAE VAT Settings and Account doctypes, granting read/write/create access to specific roles.

methods.name: create_gratuity_rule
methods.description: Creates gratuity rules for different contract types if they do not already exist, and saves them.

methods.name: get_slab_for_limited_contract
methods.description: Returns the gratuity calculation slabs for limited contracts.

methods.name: get_slab_for_unlimited_contract_on_termination
methods.description: Returns the gratuity calculation slabs for unlimited contracts upon termination.

methods.name: get_slab_for_unlimited_contract_on_resignation
methods.description: Returns the gratuity calculation slabs for unlimited contracts upon resignation.
